task.title: To assign apps to runtime users in Designer

step.cmd: In Designer, click Settings and click App Assignment.
Under Create New Assignments, from the User Assignments section, select the Users you want to assign the app to. You can add records by Id or selection.

info.p: From the Profile Assignments section, select the Profile you want to assign the app.
